blocks.text: Predicates describe properties or relationships of objects. For example, “isEven(x)” is true if x is an even number. Variables represent objects or values in the domain of discourse. Using variables, we can write general statements like “For all x, x > 0.” Predicates and variables together form predicate logic expressions. They help express complex ideas clearly and formally. Understanding predicates and variables is important for reasoning and problem-solving.
